newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher on export demand.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher on export demand.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher on Monday, boosted by ideas export demand was picking up and by renewed commercial interest, traders said.
"We bounced from deeply oversold levels," a floor trader said. "Our market was down but the cash market has been static. It's shown no real signs of weakening."
Traders pointed to news Jamaica was in the market for PL-480 rice and floor sources suggested last week's lows had attracted additional demand.
Commercial buying interest was noted in the new crop months with Term Commodities said to be the key buyer.
Rains continued to delay Texas rice plantings which could lead to new crop yield losses, a Texas agronomist said.
Rice ended five to one cent per cwt higher with July up 3-1/2 at $11.10.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 400 lots, compared with Friday's actual volume of 951.
